content: {"reasoning":"The only documented denial is CO-97: this service is bundled into another paid service and is not separately payable, so the remaining deductible does not establish patient liability for this balance. No current denial supports another appeal or peer-to-peer review, and no claim-data error or requested information supports further rework. Although patient billing performed better historically, it is not proper for this contractual adjustment; with no secondary payer or documented collectible patient share, the balance should be written off.","action":"write_off"}
